prototype.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished original visual prototype board for two portrait Android games for children age 5-6. Flat, bright 2D children's toy illustration, cream background, mint green, sky blue, warm yellow and coral, bold rounded shapes, restrained clean outlines, simple soft graphic shadows, no photo realism, no detailed texture, no imitation of copyrighted characters. Wide landscape presentation with three large complete phone screen designs side by side, each 9:19 portrait proportion. Screen 1: a cheerful level select for a steel marble labyrinth, exactly 12 big numbered level buttons arranged 3 columns x 4 rows, a minimal header with back arrow and the Chinese title “钢珠迷宫”, tiny earned stars, no paragraphs. Screen 2: real gameplay for “钢珠迷宫”, level 3 badge, small pause icon, 3 clear star collectible counters. Most space is a large top-down rectangular maze board with a real connected easy maze route, wide corridors, rounded mint solid walls on pale cream floor. One normal small silver-blue steel marble, with a simple curved white highlight and subtle small grounded shadow, no face, no toy ears. Three golden five-point stars along the accessible path, a clearly green destination arch, a clearly identifiable dark round hazard hole well away from the introductory path. Bottom only two large icon buttons, retry and phone calibration, and a short subtle tilt-direction indicator. All controls large, few words. Screen 3: a distinct gravity toy puzzle called “翻转星星盒”: a large 5x5 wooden-toy-like flat grid of softly colored connected rooms, large internal barriers, one coral round star token and one blue round star token, each with matching simple colored goal nest. A large mint arrow indicates current gravity direction. Tilt the whole phone to make ALL tokens slide together until a wall; step puzzle, not hand steering. A little star counter and two large bottom icons undo and restart. Original simple planet/leaf decorations only outside the boards. Absolutely no marketing copy, English subtitles, tutorial paragraphs, tiny text, heavy skeuomorphism, realistic wood grain, perspective or isometric mazes. Clean intentional spacing, production-ready coherent mobile game UI visual direction. Render the three screens large and legible.

atlas.layout: 4 columns x 2 rows; precise source rectangles documented in game renderers
atlas.prompt: Create ONE production sprite atlas image on a transparent background, exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows (4x2 grid, 8 separate sprites), no grid lines, no text. Flat bright original preschool toy art, simple clean chunky silhouettes, restrained dark colored outlines, tiny simple graphic shadow/highlight, not photorealistic, no characters or faces. Each sprite centered in its own equal rectangular cell with generous 18% transparent margin on every side, no touching or overlapping cells. Row1 left to right: (1) a perfectly circular normal silver-blue STEEL MARBLE, no face, single curved white highlight, clear metal ball appearance; (2) a golden five-point collectible STAR, rounded tips; (3) a big golden simple KEY with round bow and two teeth; (4) a green arch EXIT with dark mint opening and tiny green triangular flag. Row2 left to right: (1) a CORAL RED round game token with large cream five-point star engraved on its center; (2) a SKY BLUE round game token with large cream five-point star centered; (3) a CORAL RED circular goal nest/ring with pale coral recessed center and simple darker coral star silhouette, clearly hollow destination unlike ball; (4) a SKY BLUE circular goal nest/ring with pale blue recessed center and darker blue star silhouette. All circular objects same apparent size; atlas crisp and legible at small mobile sizes. Colors cream mint yellow coral blue consistent, minimal 2D shading. Output transparent alpha around all eight isolated sprites, no background scenery or decorative flecks.
